senses.gloss:
पह्लव पह्लव, आस्, m., N. of a people, the
Persians, (also spelt पह्नव; in the Viṣṇu-Purāṇa
they are said to be a degraded Kṣatriya race con-
quered by Sagara and sentenced by him to wear
beards, see Wilson's Viṣṇu-Purāṇa, p. 375.)

पह्लिका पह्लिका, f. Pistia Stratiotes (=
वारि-प्रश्नी).

पाहणपुर पाहण-पुर, N. of a place men-
tioned in the Śrīṣavāyaṇa portion of the Romaka-
Siddhānta.

पाहात पाहात, अस्, m. the Indian mulberry
tree, Morus Indica (= ब्रह्म-दारु).
